plugins.name: cockroachdb
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code directly to your CockroachDB clusters for hands-on database work — explore schemas, write optimized SQL, debug queries, and manage distributed database clusters. This plugin provides tools across MCP backends (self-hosted MCP Toolbox and managed CockroachDB Cloud MCP Server), specialized agents (DBA, Developer, Operator), skills across operational domains, and built-in safety hooks.

skills.name: benchmarking-transaction-patterns
skills.description: Guides benchmarking and comparing explicit multi-statement transactions versus single-statement CTE transactions in CockroachDB, with fair test methodology, contention analysis, and performance interpretation. Use when comparing transaction formulations, benchmarking CockroachDB workloads under contention, investigating retry pressure, or deciding whether to rewrite multi-step application flows into single SQL statements.
headings: Create a pgbench script file: explicit_transfer.sql
SELECT balance FROM accounts WHERE id = :from_id;
UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - :amount WHERE id = :from_id;
UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + :amount WHERE id = :to_id;
INSERT INTO transfers (from_acct, to_acct, amount, created_at) VALUES (:from_id, :to_id, :amount, now());
skills.description_zh: 比较 CockroachDB 显式多语句事务和单语句 CTE 事务，按公平测试方法分析竞争、重试压力与性能，帮助判断是否将多步骤应用流程改为单 SQL。

skills.name: designing-application-transactions
skills.description: Guides application developers in designing correct and performant transaction patterns for CockroachDB, covering transaction lifetime, implicit vs explicit transactions, retry handling with exponential backoff, pushing invariants into SQL, selective pessimistic locking, set-based operations, connection pooling, prepared statements, keyset pagination, follower reads, and separating business logic from database logic. Use when building applications on CockroachDB, designing transaction workflows, handling retries, optimizing application-layer database interactions, or configuring connection pools.
headings: 2. Use Implicit Transactions for Single Statements
3. Use Explicit Transactions for Grouped Statements and Handle Retries
5. Push Invariants into SQL — Avoid Read-Modify-Write Loops
7. Use Set-Based Operations Over Row-by-Row Loops
8. Use Follower Reads for Non-Critical Queries
9. Use Keyset Pagination Instead of OFFSET/LIMIT
10. Use Prepared Statements for Performance and Security
11. Use Column Projections Instead of SELECT *
12. Design Keys and Indexes to Distribute Load
14. Separate Business Logic from Database Logic
skills.description_zh: 指导 CockroachDB 应用事务设计，涵盖生命周期、隐式/显式事务、指数退避重试、SQL 不变量、选择性悲观锁、集合操作、连接池、预编译语句、键集分页和 follower reads，区分业务与数据库逻辑。

skills.name: designing-multi-region-applications
skills.description: Guides developers in selecting and implementing multi-region patterns for CockroachDB applications, covering active-passive vs active-active architectures, REGIONAL BY ROW, GLOBAL tables, manual geo-partitioning with lease preferences, and live demo setup with validation queries. Use when designing multi-region database topologies, choosing between REGIONAL BY ROW and manual partitioning, building multi-region demos, or optimizing cross-region latency.
headings: Step 1: Identify the Application Write Model
skills.description_zh: 选择并实现 CockroachDB 多地区应用模式，比较主备/双活、REGIONAL BY ROW、GLOBAL 表与带 lease preference 的手动地理分区，支持示例搭建和验证查询，优化跨区延迟。

skills.name: analyzing-range-distribution
skills.description: Analyzes CockroachDB range distribution across tables and indexes using SHOW RANGES to identify range count, size patterns, leaseholder placement, and replication health. Use when investigating hotspots, uneven data distribution, range fragmentation, or validating zone configuration effects without DB Console access.
skills.description_zh: 通过 SHOW RANGES 分析 CockroachDB 表和索引的 range 数量、大小、leaseholder 分布和副本健康，诊断热点、不均衡与碎片，并验证 zone 配置，无需 DB Console。

skills.name: analyzing-schema-change-storage-risk
skills.description: Estimates storage requirements for CockroachDB online schema change backfills using SHOW RANGES WITH DETAILS, KEYS, INDEXES. Use before CREATE INDEX, ADD COLUMN with INDEX/UNIQUE, ALTER PRIMARY KEY, CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW, CREATE TABLE AS, REFRESH, or SET LOCALITY on tables with large per-index footprints, to avoid mid-backfill disk exhaustion.
headings: How much temporary space does a backfill actually need?
What happens if the cluster runs out of disk mid-backfill?
Step 1 — Check free space per store
Step 2 — Estimate the affected table/index size
skills.name_hint: analyzing · 结构 · change · storage · risk
skills.description_zh: 在大型表在线结构变更前，用 SHOW RANGES WITH DETAILS、KEYS、INDEXES 估算回填存储需求，适用于建索引、修改主键、物化视图、CTAS、刷新与 locality 变更，防止磁盘耗尽。

skills.name: auditing-table-statistics
skills.description: Audits optimizer table statistics for staleness, missing coverage, and data quality issues using SHOW STATISTICS. Use when diagnosing poor query performance, unexpected plan changes, or after bulk data changes to identify stale statistics requiring refresh via CREATE STATISTICS.
headings: Query 1: Identify Tables with Stale or Missing Statistics
Query 2: Audit Statistics for Specific Table
Workflow 2: Diagnose Unexpected Query Plan Changes
skills.description_zh: 通过 SHOW STATISTICS 审计 CockroachDB 优化器统计的时效、覆盖和质量，诊断慢查询或计划变化，并识别批量更新后需 CREATE STATISTICS 刷新的统计。

skills.name: monitoring-background-jobs
skills.description: Monitors CockroachDB background job health by identifying failed, paused, and long-running jobs using SHOW JOBS and SHOW AUTOMATIC JOBS. Surfaces schema changes, backups/restores, automatic statistics collection, and SQL stats compaction jobs without DB Console access. Use when investigating schema change delays, failed backups, or automatic job issues.
headings: Query 4: Schema Changes Waiting for MVCC GC
Query 6: Jobs by Type and Status
skills.description_zh: 通过 SHOW JOBS 和 SHOW AUTOMATIC JOBS 监控 CockroachDB 失败、暂停或长时间后台任务，涵盖结构变更、备份恢复、自动统计和 SQL 统计压缩，无需 DB Console。

skills.name: profiling-statement-fingerprints
skills.description: Ranks and analyzes statement fingerprints using aggregated SQL statistics from crdb_internal.statement_statistics to identify slow, resource-intensive, or error-prone query patterns. Use when investigating historical performance trends, identifying optimization opportunities, or diagnosing recurring slowness without DB Console access.
headings: Query 1: Top Statements by Mean Run Latency
Query 6: Memory and Disk Spill Detection
skills.description_zh: 使用 crdb_internal.statement_statistics 汇总 SQL 指纹，识别慢、资源密集或易出错的模式，分析历史趋势和反复慢查询，无需 DB Console。

skills.name: profiling-transaction-fingerprints
skills.description: Analyzes transaction fingerprints using aggregated statistics from crdb_internal.transaction_statistics to identify high-retry transactions, contention patterns, and commit latency issues. Provides historical transaction-level analysis to understand which statement combinations are causing retries, contention, or performance degradation. Use when investigating transaction retry storms, analyzing commit latency trends, or understanding statement composition of problematic transactions without DB Console access.
headings: Query 1: Top Transactions by Retries and Contention
skills.description_zh: 使用 crdb_internal.transaction_statistics 汇总事务指纹，分析高重试、竞争、提交延迟及问题语句组合，适用于历史趋势与重试风暴诊断。

skills.name: triaging-live-sql-activity
skills.description: Diagnoses live CockroachDB cluster performance issues by identifying long-running queries, busy sessions, and active transactions using SQL-only interfaces. Use when users report cluster slowness, high CPU, or need to find runaway queries and their source applications without DB Console access.
headings: Drill-Down by Application, User, or Client
skills.description_zh: 通过纯 SQL 定位 CockroachDB 集群长查询、繁忙会话和活跃事务，诊断高 CPU、集群变慢及失控查询的来源应用，无需 DB Console。

skills.name: molt-fetch
skills.description: Guide for using molt fetch to migrate data from PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or MSSQL to CockroachDB. Use when running molt fetch commands, configuring storage backends, handling fetch failures/resumption, or chaining fetch with verify.
skills.description_zh: 使用 molt fetch 将 PostgreSQL、MySQL、Oracle 或 MSSQL 数据迁移至 CockroachDB，说明命令、存储后端、失败续传及与 verify 衔接。

skills.name: molt-replicator
skills.description: Guide for using the CockroachDB replicator to continuously replicate changes from PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle to CockroachDB after an initial molt fetch data load. Use when setting up CDC replication, configuring pglogical/mylogical/oraclelogminer, or managing the fetch → replicator cutover workflow.
headings: Step 1: Initial bulk load with molt fetch
Step 3: Create staging database on target
preflight only takes --stagingConn and --targetConn (always required for the
target; stagingConn required if the target is not CRDB)
Watch for: mutations applied, unapplied mutations, lag
skills.description_zh: 在初始 molt fetch 后，通过 CockroachDB replicator 持续复制 PostgreSQL、MySQL 或 Oracle 变更，配置 CDC、pglogical/mylogical/oraclelogminer 并管理切换流程。

skills.name: molt-verify
skills.description: Guide for using molt verify to compare source and target databases for schema and row-level consistency after a migration. Use when running verify commands, tuning concurrency/sharding, handling schema mismatches, or validating data integrity post-migration.
headings: Default: CPU-count tables in parallel, 1 shard/table, 20k rows/batch
Large tables: parallelize within a single table
skills.description_zh: 使用 molt verify 核对迁移后源与目标库的结构和逐行一致性，调整并发/分片，处理结构不符并验证数据完整性。

skills.name: setting-up-local-cluster
skills.description: Downloads and starts a local CockroachDB cluster for development using the official binary. Use when a developer needs a local CockroachDB instance, when no cluster is available, or when setting up a new development environment.
headings: Setting Up a Local CockroachDB Cluster
Start 3 nodes with separate SQL, RPC, and HTTP ports.
Use $HOME instead of ~ in --store / --log-dir / --pid-file: tilde does not
expand inside --flag=~/... in bash or zsh.
Initialize the cluster (only needed on first start)
skills.description_zh: 下载官方二进制并启动本地 CockroachDB 开发集群，适用于无可用集群或新开发环境。

skills.name: managing-certificates-and-encryption
skills.description: Manages TLS certificate and encryption key lifecycle across all tiers. Self-Hosted covers certificate expiry monitoring, node/CA/client cert rotation, and Kubernetes cert management. Advanced/BYOC covers managed TLS (no action) and CMEK (Customer-Managed Encryption Key) rotation in your KMS. Standard and Basic have fully managed TLS and encryption with no customer action. CMEK is only available on Advanced. Use when monitoring cert health, performing rotation, managing CMEK, or responding to key compromise.
headings: Inspect certs locally on each node
Or read a specific cert file
Or scrape the per-node Prometheus endpoint (UNIX seconds for ca, node, client_ca, ui_ca)
skills.description_zh: 按 CockroachDB 部署档位管理 TLS 与加密密钥生命周期：自托管支持证书监测/轮换及 Kubernetes 证书；Advanced/BYOC 支持 KMS 中 CMEK 轮换，Standard/Basic 的 TLS 与加密全托管；CMEK 仅 Advanced 可用。

skills.name: managing-cluster-capacity
skills.description: Manages CockroachDB cluster capacity across all tiers. Self-Hosted covers node decommissioning for permanent removal and adding nodes for expansion. Advanced/BYOC covers scaling node count and machine size via Cloud Console, API, or Terraform. Standard covers adjusting provisioned compute (vCPUs). Basic auto-scales — guidance covers spending limits and cost management. Use when scaling capacity up or down, permanently removing nodes, or managing costs.
headings: All nodes live, version-consistent, with replication and per-node range counts
Step 2: Decommission (multiple nodes — more efficient, do simultaneously)
Confirm the dead node and verify replication has caught up
skills.description_zh: 按 CockroachDB 档位管理容量与费用：自托管增节点或 decommission 永久移除，Advanced/BYOC 调整节点/机型，Standard 调整 vCPU，Basic 自动扩缩并管理支出上限。

skills.name: managing-cluster-settings
skills.description: Reviews, audits, and modifies CockroachDB cluster settings. Self-Hosted has full control over all settings and start flags. Advanced/BYOC can modify most SQL-level settings but infrastructure settings are managed by CRL. Standard has limited settings access — session variables are the primary tuning mechanism. Basic has minimal settings — use session variables and Cloud Console. Use when auditing configuration, tuning performance, or troubleshooting settings-related issues.
skills.description_zh: 按档位审查和调整 CockroachDB 设置：自托管可控全部设置/启动参数，Advanced/BYOC 多数 SQL 设置可改，Standard/Basic 主要使用会话变量与云控制台，基础设施由平台管理。

skills.name: performing-cluster-maintenance
skills.description: Manages planned cluster maintenance across all tiers. Self-Hosted covers node drain procedures for OS patching, hardware changes, and configuration updates. Advanced/BYOC covers maintenance window configuration, patch scheduling, deferral policies, and monitoring during CRL-managed maintenance. Standard and Basic maintenance is fully managed with no customer action. Use when planning maintenance, configuring maintenance windows, or preparing applications for maintenance events.
headings: Operator handles drain automatically during pod eviction
If missing, create: cockroach debug ballast <store-path>/auxiliary/EMERGENCY_BALLAST --size=1GiB
skills.description_zh: 安排 CockroachDB 计划维护：自托管排空节点进行系统补丁/硬件/配置变更，Advanced/BYOC 配置维护窗口、补丁延迟与监控，Standard/Basic 由平台全托管。

skills.name: provisioning-cluster-for-production
skills.description: Guides initial CockroachDB cluster provisioning and production deployment. Self-Hosted covers cockroach start/init, Kubernetes deployment (Operator, Helm), hardware sizing, and production configuration. Advanced/BYOC covers Cloud Console, API, and Terraform provisioning with production settings. Standard covers cluster creation and provisioned compute selection. Basic covers cluster creation and spending limits. Use when creating a new cluster, preparing for production go-live, or validating deployment configuration.
headings: Apply CrdbCluster manifest with node count, resources, and storage
skills.description_zh: 按档位配置 CockroachDB 生产集群：自托管 start/init、Kubernetes Operator/Helm 和硬件规格，Advanced/BYOC 用 Console/API/Terraform，Standard 选预置计算，Basic 设支出上限，并检查上线配置。

skills.name: reviewing-cluster-health
skills.description: Performs a comprehensive health check of a CockroachDB cluster. Gathers deployment context first, then provides tier-appropriate diagnostics. Self-Hosted uses SQL against node-level system tables and CLI. Advanced/BYOC use Cloud Console and SQL with node visibility. Standard monitors provisioned compute and workload via Cloud Console. Basic monitors Request Unit consumption and connectivity. Use for daily checks, pre-maintenance validation, post-incident verification, or production readiness assessment.
headings: Check 1: Node Liveness, Version, and Replication
Node count, liveness, and locality diversity
Node liveness, version, and replication status
skills.description_zh: 先确定部署档位，再开展 CockroachDB 全面健康检查：自托管用节点系统表与 CLI，Advanced/BYOC 用控制台/SQL 节点诊断，Standard 查计算与工作负载，Basic 查 Request Unit 与连通性，适用于日检、维护和事故后验证。

skills.name: upgrading-cluster-version
skills.description: Guides CockroachDB version upgrades with tier-appropriate procedures. Self-Hosted covers manual rolling binary replacement with finalization control. Advanced/BYOC covers Console-initiated major upgrades, maintenance windows for patches, and release channel selection. Standard and Basic upgrades are fully automatic with no customer action required. Use when planning, executing, or monitoring a version upgrade.
headings: All nodes live, version-consistent, fully replicated
Rolling Node Upgrade (repeat for each node)
skills.description_zh: 按档位指导 CockroachDB 版本升级：自托管滚动替换二进制并控制 finalization，Advanced/BYOC 在控制台发起大版本升级、配置补丁窗口和发布通道，Standard/Basic 自动升级。

skills.name: cockroachdb-sql
skills.description: Use when writing, generating, or optimizing SQL for CockroachDB, designing CockroachDB schemas, or when the user asks about CockroachDB-specific SQL patterns, type mappings, and distributed database best practices. Also use when encountering CockroachDB anti-patterns like missing primary keys, sequential ID hotspots, or incorrect type usage.
headings: Schema Design — UUID Primary Key (Avoid Hotspots)
skills.description_zh: 编写、生成或优化 CockroachDB SQL 与表结构，说明类型映射和分布式实践，诊断缺少主键、顺序 ID 热点或错误类型等反模式。

skills.name: auditing-cis-benchmark
skills.description: Audits a self-hosted CockroachDB cluster against the CIS CockroachDB Benchmark v1.0.0 Level 1 controls. Supports two audit depths — quick automated scans and full CIS audit procedures. Produces a structured PASS/FAIL/MANUAL report covering installation, system hardening, logging, user access, data protection, and CockroachDB settings. Use when preparing for CIS compliance assessments, hardening self-hosted deployments, or validating security posture against industry benchmarks.
skills.description_zh: 按 CIS CockroachDB Benchmark v1.0.0 Level 1 审计自托管集群，支持快速自动扫描或完整程序，输出安装、系统加固、日志、用户、数据保护和设置的 PASS/FAIL/MANUAL 报告。

skills.name: auditing-cloud-cluster-security
skills.description: Audits the security posture of a CockroachDB cluster (Cloud or self-hosted) across network, authentication, authorization, encryption, audit logging, and backup dimensions. Use when assessing cluster security readiness, preparing for compliance reviews, or investigating security configuration gaps.
headings: Check openssl version (v3+ recommended for PQC probes)

Get cluster details (use cluster name or ID)
Gather metadata via SQL and cockroach CLI
skills.description_zh: 从网络、认证、授权、加密、审计日志和备份维度审查云端或自托管 CockroachDB 安全姿态，适用于上线准备、合规评审与配置缺口调查。

skills.name: configuring-audit-logging
skills.description: Configures SQL audit logging on CockroachDB clusters to capture security-relevant events including authentication, privilege changes, and sensitive data access. Use when enabling audit logging for compliance, setting up role-based audit policies, or verifying audit configuration.

skills.description_zh: 配置 CockroachDB SQL 审计日志，记录认证、权限变更和敏感数据访问，建立按角色的审计策略并验证配置。

skills.name: configuring-ip-allowlists
skills.description: Configures and hardens IP allowlists for CockroachDB Cloud clusters to restrict network access to authorized CIDR ranges. Use when tightening network security, removing overly permissive allowlist entries like 0.0.0.0/0, or setting up allowlists for a new cluster.

Add a specific CIDR range (CIDR is a positional argument)

skills.name: configuring-log-export
skills.description: Configures log and metric export for CockroachDB Cloud clusters to external monitoring services including AWS CloudWatch, GCP Cloud Logging, and Datadog. Use when setting up log export for audit compliance, configuring metric export for monitoring, or troubleshooting log delivery issues.

skills.name: configuring-private-connectivity
skills.description: Configures private network connectivity for CockroachDB Cloud clusters including AWS PrivateLink, GCP Private Service Connect, Azure Private Link, egress private endpoints, and VPC peering. Use when setting up private endpoints to eliminate public internet exposure, configuring egress to external services like Kafka, or establishing VPC peering.

Create the Private Service Connect endpoint

Register the private endpoint connection with the cluster

skills.name: configuring-sso-and-scim
skills.description: Configures SSO authentication and SCIM 2.0 provisioning for CockroachDB across four distinct layers — Cloud Console SSO (SAML/OIDC), DB Console SSO (OIDC), SQL/Cluster SSO (JWT or LDAP/AD), and SCIM 2.0 automated provisioning. Azure AD / Entra ID Specific Issues

skills.name: enabling-cmek-encryption
skills.description: Enables Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on CockroachDB Cloud clusters with the Advanced plan and Advanced Security Add-on to give organizations control over data-at-rest encryption keys via their cloud provider's KMS. skills.name: enforcing-password-policies
skills.description: Configures and enforces password policies on CockroachDB clusters including minimum length, complexity requirements, and hash cost settings. Use when strengthening authentication requirements, setting up password policies for a new cluster, or meeting compliance password standards.
headings: 5. Address Existing Users with Weak Passwords
skills.description_zh: 配置 CockroachDB 密码最小长度、复杂度和哈希成本，强化认证或满足新集群/合规密码要求。

skills.name: hardening-user-privileges
skills.description: Hardens CockroachDB user privileges by auditing and tightening role-based access control, reducing admin grants, restricting PUBLIC role permissions, and applying least-privilege principles. Use when reducing excessive privileges, cleaning up admin access, or implementing RBAC best practices.
skills.description_zh: 审查并收紧 CockroachDB RBAC 权限，减少管理员授权、限制 PUBLIC 角色并落实最小权限，清理过度访问。

skills.name: managing-tls-certificates
skills.description: Manages TLS certificates for CockroachDB clusters including CA certificate configuration, client certificate authentication, certificate rotation, and troubleshooting SSL/TLS connection errors. Use when setting up client certificate auth, resolving SSL connection failures, rotating certificates, or configuring mTLS for CDC changefeeds.

skills.name: preparing-compliance-documentation
skills.description: Guides preparation of compliance documentation for CockroachDB Cloud deployments, covering SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR certifications. Use when responding to compliance questionnaires, preparing for audits, locating certification documents, or assessing cluster configuration for compliance readiness.

Verify in Cloud Console > Organization Settings > Authentication
Look for log_export_config in cluster info output
skills.description_zh: 准备 CockroachDB Cloud 的 SOC 2、PCI DSS、ISO 27001、HIPAA 和 GDPR 合规资料，回应问卷、查找认证文件和评估配置准备度。
